Name: Tobijah
Summary: Tobijah (KJV 'Tobiah' in Zechariah 6:14) was one of the exiles from Babylon who brought silver and gold to Jerusalem for the crowning of Joshua the high priest (Zechariah 6:10). He is not Tobiah the Ammonite opponent of Nehemiah — a different man in a different generation.
KeyStory: Tobijah, with Heldai, Jedaiah, and Josiah son of Zephaniah, brought gifts from Babylon for the crown placed on Joshua's head.
RelatedPeople: Heldai; Jedaiah; Josiah, Son of Zephaniah
LifeLesson: Two Tobiahs, opposite stories: one brought gifts to crown the priest, the other opposed the wall. The name is the same; the choice is everything.
